title: Canonical Brand
description: PRO's canonical brand contract: a brand PRO sells, the vendor that supplies it, and how its products reach the dealer. PRO owns this contract; SQL is the system of record. A brand belongs to at most one vendor and references it by vendorId; the vendor record does not list its brands. Products, member brand entitlements, and rebates reference brandId. REQUIRED: identity, name, and status only. Unknown fields are rejected. Pricing, rebates, and web content are not brand data and do not appear here.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. Additive changes bump the minor version; breaking changes create a new major version.

brandId.description: Canonical, immutable brand identifier owned by PRO SQL. Never another system's id (those live in references).

vendorId.description: Canonical vendorId of the vendor that supplies this brand. Null while a brand has not been assigned. Several brands may share one vendor.

supply.description: How this brand's products reach the dealer. The decision for one order line is made per product; these are the brand-level settings that feed it.

directShipAll.description: Every product of this brand ships direct from the vendor. When false, only products flagged direct vendor ship do, and the rest ship from PRO's warehouse.

stockedInWarehouse.description: PRO stocks this brand in its own warehouse. Informational: it does not route orders.

references.description: This brand's id in every other system, keyed by system.

extensions.description: Namespaced fields that only one system cares about. A field is promoted to canonical only when two or more systems need it.

allOf.description: A brand that ships everything direct must say which vendor ships it.
A brand cannot both ship everything direct and be stocked in the warehouse.
